property_summary: A forward MUST revert if the external call fails.
If an external call initiated via forward receives insufficient gas, the transaction must revert.
A forward call that supplies insufficient gas to a recipient that consumes all gas and reverts must itself revert.
A forward call that supplies gas below 21000 to a recipient that consumes all gas and reverts must itself revert.
